strings.Wymagane teraz: TAK – wczytywanie ujęć w: Required now: YES – loading video shots (MP4 / MOV) and previews. Installs ffmpeg via winget (Gyan.FFmpeg, approx. 100 MB, accepts its licence on your behalf); if winget does not work – downloads the portable package from gyan.dev to MatteDesk bin/ffmpeg. The path is saved to config.local.json.
strings.Wymagane teraz: TAK – Doktor klonuje nim: Required now: YES – Doctor uses it to clone ComfyUI nodes from GitHub (MatAnyone2, VideoHelperSuite, DepthCrafter) and to install CoTracker3. Installs Git for Windows via winget (Git.Git, approx. 60 MB, accepts its licence on your behalf); Windows may ask for administrator consent.
strings.Kopiuje węzły PlateMatte i MatAnyone2-Ke: Copies the PlateMatte and MatAnyone2-Keyframes nodes to ComfyUI custom_nodes (old version → backups/).
strings.Instaluje pakiet CoTracker3 w Pythonie C: Installs the CoTracker3 package into ComfyUI's Python (< 1 MB, ComfyUI's PyTorch stays unchanged) and downloads the scaled_offline.pth weights (97 MB). CoTracker3 then runs on the GPU through ComfyUI.
strings.Wymagane teraz: TAK – strefy z presetem: Required now: YES – zones with the "hair" preset and the "vitmatte" engine. Downloads ViTMatte weights (hustvl/vitmatte-base-composition-1k, ~390 MB) to the Hugging Face cache; transformers is installed into ComfyUI's Python only if missing. ViTMatte then runs on the GPU in ComfyUI's Python.
strings.Klonuje węzeł ComfyUI-MatAnyone2 (github: Clones the ComfyUI-MatAnyone2 node (github.com/spiritform/comfy-matanyone2) into ComfyUI custom_nodes (if not present), installs its requirements and runs its install.py in ComfyUI's Python (matanyone2 package from GitHub pq-yang/MatAnyone2, hydra-core, thinplate; a few MB, PyTorch unchanged).
strings.Restartuje ComfyUI (przez ComfyUI-Manage: Restarts ComfyUI (via ComfyUI-Manager) and waits until it is back up (usually 30–90 s). Unsaved changes in the ComfyUI window will be lost.
strings.Klonuje węzły DepthCrafter (github.com/a: Clones the DepthCrafter nodes (github.com/akatz-ai/ComfyUI-DepthCrafter-Nodes) into ComfyUI custom_nodes and installs their requirements. Required now: no (only the "Depth" feature). Used for: shot depth map (stage 0). The model (approx. 4–6 GB) downloads itself on first use.
strings.Wymagane teraz: TAK – ujęcia 8-bitowe (P: Required now: YES – 8-bit shots (PNG/JPG) in SAM 3.1, MatAnyone2 and zones (VHS_LoadImagesPath node). Clones ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite (github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, approx. 1 MB) into ComfyUI custom_nodes and installs its requirements in ComfyUI's Python (imageio-ffmpeg approx. 30 MB; opencv is usually already there).
strings.Wymagane teraz: nie – tylko etap 4 „Vide: Required now: no – only stage 4 "VideoMaMa" (optional). Used for: hair strands and edge detail from mask 1+2. Clones the ComfyUI-VideoMaMa node (github.com/okdalto/ComfyUI-VideoMaMa) into ComfyUI custom_nodes and downloads 7.1 GB of weights (VideoMaMa UNet 6.1 GB from huggingface.co/SammyLim/VideoMaMa + SVD-xt image encoder and VAE 1.5 GB) to models/videomama. After installing the node – restart ComfyUI.
strings.Wymagane teraz: nie – tylko etap 7 „LTX-: Required now: no – only stage 7 "LTX-2.5 Alpha-Gen" (optional). Used for: generative alpha for hair, smoke, motion blur. Downloads approx. 40 GB (transformer int8 21.5 GB, Gemma int8 15.4 GB, VAE 1.8 GB, LoRA Alpha-Gen 1.3 GB) from huggingface.co/Lightricks to models/ (interrupted downloads resume). Requires a Hugging Face login ("hf auth login") and "Agree and Access" on the Lightricks/LTX-2.5 and Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Alpha-Gen pages.

strings.Miękka krawędź MatAnyone2 z maski 1+2 (b: MatAnyone2 soft edge from mask 1+2 (no ViTMatte zones)
strings.MatAnyone2 liczy miękką krawędź alfy w p: MatAnyone2 computes the soft alpha edge in a band around mask 1+2 (SAM 3.1 core + brush fixes), temporally, without ViTMatte zones – this is the base version. An object linked with parts (layers) is computed once as a whole with a seam; the parts get their share in the export.
strings.naturalnej krawędzi postaci i obiektów (: natural edges of people and objects (motion blur, defocus, soft contours); MatAnyone2 does not add or remove larger areas – only the edge.
strings.VideoMaMa: kosmyki włosów i detal krawęd: VideoMaMa: hair strands and edge detail from mask 1+2, applied over a base (mask 1+2 or the MatAnyone2 result)
strings.model VideoMaMa (na priorze Stable Video: the VideoMaMa model (on a Stable Video Diffusion prior) computes the alpha of the whole object from the image and mask 1+2, in frame batches with crossfades. The result is applied over a base: mask 1+2 (default – VideoMaMa then does the whole edge) or the MatAnyone2 result (MatAnyone2's hard edge stays in the protection band); nothing is added further than "Reach" from the base edge (background islands are removed). You change the sliders without updating the model ("✚ Sliders on result").
strings.włosów, kosmyków, futra – pojedyncze ods: hair, strands, fur – single flyaway hairs that MatAnyone2 does not separate. The result can be a ViTMatte base and an export source.
strings.Strefy ViTMatte (malowany pas / cały obr: ViTMatte zones (painted band / whole outline) on the MatAnyone2 result
strings.włosów, futra, kosmyków, dymu, włókien –: hair, fur, strands, smoke, fibres – details that MatAnyone2 does not separate from the background.
strings.Tryby krawędzi, strefy progowe, poprawka: Edge modes, threshold zones, edge fix, versions, QA, flicker map
strings.(wynik MatAnyone2 / ViTMatte / LTX-2.5,: (MatAnyone2 / ViTMatte / LTX-2.5 result, mask 1+2 or any version); QA and edge fix suggestions are computed on it, and "▶ Run from this base" makes a new version from it (MatAnyone2 / backlit / hard edge engine, "Advanced" threshold zones, optional base edge fix) with its provenance saved.
strings.eksperymentów – np. wynik ViTMatte jeszc: experiments – e.g. the ViTMatte result once more through MatAnyone2, backlit, rigid objects, threshold garbage matte.
strings.LTX-2.5 Alpha-Gen: generatywna alfa z sa: LTX-2.5 Alpha-Gen: generative alpha from the image alone, guided by mask 1+2 (other objects painted out)
strings.model LTX-2.5 (22B) z IC-LoRA Alpha-Gen: the LTX-2.5 (22B) model with IC-LoRA Alpha-Gen generates alpha by itself from the image crop – without a mask or prompt; the model picks the foreground itself, and mask 1+2 clips the result to the object region (objects in front are subtracted by the export; "Isolate" paints out other objects standing NEXT to it). Batches of 8k+1 frames with crossfades.
strings.półprzezroczystych i cienkich rzeczy – w: semi-transparent and thin things – backlit hair, smoke, fabrics, motion blur – when MatAnyone2 / ViTMatte lose detail. Generative: check the result (A / B against the MatAnyone2 version). Requires the LTX-2.5 models (~40 GB, Doctor).

strings.Preset cienkie (trawa, gałęzie, anteny):: Thin preset (grass, branches, antennae): islands in the zone are not removed

strings.Rdzeń + alpha strefy na tle compu (V zmi: Core + zone alpha on the comp background (V changes the background)
strings.Trimapa strefy: niebieskie = FG (rdzeń),: Zone trimap: blue = FG (core), yellow = unknown (matting computes here), rest = background
strings.Mapa wag silników: niebieski = chroma, c: Engine weight map: blue = chroma, red = knn, green = clean / other
strings.Zaproponuj strefę (krok 9): SAM 3.1 z op: Suggest zone (step 9): SAM 3.1 with the zone description on the object crop minus the core + soft edges outside the core → suggestions (yellow numbered polygons); ✓ creates a zone with the selected preset, ✕ rejects
strings.co wyciąć, czego pozbyć się z tła (np. w: what to cut out, what to remove from the background (e.g. hair, no gold line)
strings.np. mniej tła przy uchu – zapisze się z: e.g. less background near the ear – saved with the next stroke
strings.Pętla korekty (krok 7): tekst trafia do: Correction loop (step 7): the text goes into this frame's zone key together with the next + / − stroke and into the zone iteration history; prompt rules (step 9) read it in this frame. Ctrl+Z restores the previous key with its note
strings.Suwaki strefy (obszar, wygładzanie w cza: Zone sliders (area, temporal smoothing, finishing): the "Zone" palette on the preview (drag by ⠿)
strings.Przerywany obrys obszaru ViTMatte (pas,: Dashed outline of the ViTMatte area (the band it computes in) and the "Core inset" preview while dragging. Turn off to see the result alone
strings.Podgląd pasa ViTMatte na obrazie (wł. /: ViTMatte band preview on image (on / off)
strings.Zielona alfa podglądu strefy na obrazie: Green zone-preview alpha on the image (in the "On background" cut-out the preview stays – that is the result)
strings.Nowa strefa ViTMatte: namaluj pędzlem pa: New ViTMatte zone: brush a band along the hair–background edge (it may run onto the hand). The area follows the object (CoTracker3, local); a brush fix in any frame creates a key. Object parts (e.g. hand) are cut out of the area automatically
strings.Nowa strefa ViTMatte wzdłuż całego obrys: New ViTMatte zone along the whole object outline (hair preset). Then mark the areas of this object WITHOUT hair (face, neck, skin) – ViTMatte does not compute them. Hand / object in front: order it BEFORE this object (holdout)
strings.Strefa = obszar namalowany pędzlem (wiel: Zone: area painted with the brush (polygons work too); follows the object, each fix creates a key
strings.Strefa = pas wokół całego obrysu rdzenia: Zone: band around the whole SAM 3.1 core outline; the drawing and selected objects are CUT OUT of it
strings.Pędzel: maluj obszar, w którym liczy ViT: Brush: paint the area where ViTMatte computes [G]; size: brush slider on the left or [ ]
strings.Pędzel: zmaż obszar (ViTMatte tu nie lic: Brush: erase area (ViTMatte does not compute here) [R]
strings.Pędzel: wymuszone tło (np. linia na ścia: Brush: forced background (e.g. a line on the wall running through the hair)
strings.Obszar przenoszony między klatkami punkt: Area carried between frames by local CoTracker3 points (each fragment follows its nearest points – keeps up with hair motion and deformation); points never on object parts (e.g. hand) or on objects in front. Off = rigid shape
strings.Śledzenie lokalne obszaru (CoTracker3):: Local area tracking (CoTracker3): on = the area keeps up with hair motion and deformation; off = rigid shape
strings.Maski innych policzonych obiektów (alpha: Masks of other computed objects (alpha of the active version, otherwise the core) cut out of the ViTMatte band – the base result stays there. For parts of the same object (face, neck). An object in front (hand) is better ordered before this object: holdout = alpha 0 under it, and ViTMatte computes hair right up to its edge (CLIP2_A v069 vs v067)
strings.Wygładzanie alfy ViTMatte w czasie (cała: Temporal smoothing of ViTMatte alpha (whole zone, on "Apply"). Flow-based average: first black / white clip in each frame, then a weighted average over ±radius frames aligned by flow – junk from one frame does not smear onto neighbours (CLIP2_A: −16 % / −18 % flicker)
strings.Ile klatek w każdą stronę bierze wygładz: How many frames each way the smoothing uses (more = calmer, but slower and higher risk of smearing on fast motion)
strings.Wygładzanie na kadrze powiększonym ×2 (c: Smoothing on a ×2 upscaled crop (thin strands are wider, flow holds them better); only the correction goes back to the result
strings.Czym liczona jest alfa w strefie. ViTMat: What computes the alpha in the zone. ViTMatte = best individual strands (settings like the ViTMatte node in Nuke below); MatAnyone2 = more temporally consistent with blur / motion
strings.Obiekt połączony z częściami szwem: stre: Object joined to its parts by a seam: the zone computes on the whole group. Checked member = certain foreground (cut out of the zone area, alpha 1); unchecked = its edge is computed by the zone engine (e.g. hair of the "head" part)
strings.Wagi ViTMatte. base = „High detail” z Nu: ViTMatte weights. base = Nuke's "High detail" (default, best strands); small = faster, more haze; base – distinctions = trained on a different dataset (sometimes better on fur / fibres). Models are in the Hugging Face cache (downloaded by the Doctor / on first use)
strings.Bok kadru strefy, który widzi model (Nuk: Side of the zone crop the model sees (Nuke "Downrez" inverted): 1008 = crop upscaled as for MatAnyone2 (≤ 3×, default); 504 = ½ (faster, CLIP2_A measurement ≈ Nuke's result); more = finer strands, slower and more VRAM
strings.Nuke „Fine Tune”: poziom, jaki pas „unkn: Nuke "Fine Tune": the level the "unknown" band gets in the trimap channel. 0.5 = neutral (default); less = the model adds more cautiously (0.3 cuts strands); more = bolder (0.7 = haze in the background)
strings.Alfa poniżej tej wartości → 0 (usuwa mgi: Alpha below this value → 0 (removes haze and small background junk); linear up to white, no step. With the flow-based average it acts BEFORE smoothing
strings.Drugie obcięcie czerni PO wygładzaniu w: Second black clip AFTER temporal smoothing: averaging neighbouring frames creates new low values (haze on fast motion, CLIP2_A F18) – this slider removes them (ViTMatte)
strings.Alfa powyżej tej wartości → 1 (domyka pr: Alpha above this value → 1 (closes almost-full strands and the edge)
strings.Rozmycie Gaussa alfy strefy w px (po wyg: Gaussian blur of zone alpha in px (after smoothing); the core stays 1
strings.Przywróć wygładzanie i wykończenie z pre: Restore smoothing and finishing from the zone preset

strings.Model krawędzi w strefie. ViTMatte: base: Edge model of the zone. ViTMatte: base = Nuke's "High detail" (default, best strands); small = faster, more haze; base – distinctions = trained on a different dataset (sometimes better on fur / fibres) – ViTMatte weights are for non-commercial use only (Adobe dataset). BiRefNet_HR-matting (2048 px) / Lucida (1024 px) = MIT weights, commercial use too; they compute the alpha from the image alone, the trimap only clips the result to the band. Models are in the Hugging Face cache (downloaded by the Doctor)

strings.ViTMatte liczy półprzezroczystą alfę tyl: ViTMatte computes semi-transparent alpha only in the zone – a band around the whole outline that follows the object; you set the band width with band points (whiskers: outside / inside, 0 = a gap, e.g. skin); the result is applied over a base of your choice: the MatAnyone2 version from stage 3 or mask 1+2 (then the stage works right after stages 1 + 2). A group (object + parts) is computed by the main object as a whole with a seam. A / B / difference comparison – below.
strings.Dodawanie punktów kontrolnych pasa (Esc: Adding band control points (Esc = done): click on the image near the outline = new point; two whiskers – yellow = band outside (into the background), blue = inside (into the object); drag a whisker end = width in this frame (key), drag the point = its position (key); 0 / 0 = a gap in the band (e.g. skin, a hand). Between keys the width animates, CoTracker3 tracks the points. RMB on a point = delete this frame's key (the last key deletes the point)

strings.Rozdzielczość, w której liczy MatAnyone2: Resolution at which MatAnyone2 computes (MatAnyone2 edge mode): lower = faster and less VRAM, but softer / blurrier hair edges; temporal context (frame memory) unchanged. auto = 9-frame trial from 1.0 (crop > 2048 px from 0.75, > 2600 px from 0.5), lower when VRAM > 11 GB or when ComfyUI spills card memory to system RAM; on long shots the full pass can still spill to RAM and slow down drastically – then pick 0.75 / 0.5. Changing it creates a new version on "Render final"

strings.Wyrównuje pulsowanie jasności i koloru:: Evens out pulsing brightness and colour: bulbs, LEDs, candles, clouds, uneven stop-motion exposure, a part of the frame flickering more than the rest. Changes brightness only (brightness maps), never redraws pixels.

strings.– gdy po deflickerze nadal „oddychają” c: – when shadows, texture or fine patterns still “breathe” after the deflicker (felt, fabric, leaf shadows). Not for fast motion, motion blur or hair – it can leave smears.
strings.– gdy mocne ziarno albo szum z wysokiego: – when heavy grain or high-ISO noise gets in the way of keying. Not when the grain must stay in the final image (then denoise in Nuke for the key only).
strings.– jasność dużych płaskich obszarów porów: – brightness of large flat areas compared with ±15 neighbouring frames (the left side pulses, the right does not). When this is enough, the next two parts are skipped automatically.
strings.– każdy z 54 prostokątów kadru wygładzan: – each of the 54 rectangles of the frame smoothed in time on its own (touches up e.g. one corner).
strings.– jedna korekta R / G / B na klatkę, wyg: – one R / G / B correction per frame, smoothed in time while keeping the trend (overall pumping of brightness or colour).
strings.Ile razy stopień „obszary” poprawia mapę: How many times the “areas” stage refines the brightness map (iterations). Automat: from the level flicker of the strongest-flickering region
strings.Z iloma sąsiednimi klatkami porównywana: How many neighbouring frames each frame is compared with. Random pulsing → ±10; variation with memory → longer. The full run caps it at half the shot length
strings.Najmniejsza plama jasności, jaką poprawi: The smallest brightness patch the “areas” stage corrects (σ at 512 px). Less = finer patches, but a risk of texture traces
strings.Mediana wzoru faktury z ±N klatek (tylko: Median of the texture pattern over ±N frames (EXR export only, with “Texture and shadow flicker” on). Pulsing → ±4, variation with memory → ±3 / ±2
strings.Stopień „cała klatka” liczy osobną korek: The “whole frame” stage computes a separate correction for R, G and B (the light's colour drifts) or one for brightness (stable colour). Automat: from the colour measurement

strings.Brak – najszybciej (~0 s/kl.), migotanie: None – fastest (~0 s/frame), flicker unchanged. When: the zone is almost only 0 / 1 (a hard outline) or a quick preview.
strings.Mediana – szybka (~0,3 s/kl.), ale przy: Median – fast (~0.3 s/frame), but with motion it hardly reduces flicker (CLIP2_A: unchanged) – it only works where nothing moves. When: a static camera and a still object.
strings.Mediana po przepływie – najwolniejsza (~: Median along the flow – slowest (~2.8 s/frame), flicker −36 % (CLIP2_A). Kept for compatibility: the mean along the flow is faster and calmer.
strings.Średnia po przepływie – POLECANA do włos: Mean along the flow – RECOMMENDED for hair: the least flicker (CLIP2_A −44 % with ×2, −47 % with ×1), ~0.5 s/frame with ×1, ~1.5 s/frame with ×2. Black / white levels in each frame first, then a weighted mean over ± radius frames aligned by the flow – garbage of one frame is not smeared onto the others.
strings.Wygładzanie alfy w czasie (cała strefa,: Temporal smoothing of the alpha (the whole zone, on “Apply”). Time on a ~4 Mpx zone (sh060, 4K; a small zone takes a fraction), fastest first: none ~0 s/frame → median ~0.3 → mean along the flow ×1 ~0.5 → mean ×2 ~1.5 → median along the flow ~2.8 s/frame. Least flicker: the mean along the flow (CLIP2_A −44…−52 % with radius 3…5); with motion the median gives almost nothing. Details: the list items and the hint below.
strings.Ile klatek w każdą stronę bierze wygładz: How many frames each way the smoothing uses. More = calmer, but slower and a higher risk of smearing on fast motion. Mean along the flow on CLIP2_A: radius 2 −40 %, 3 −44 %, 5 −52 % flicker; radius 5 ≈ 1.5× the time of radius 3. When: 3 by default, 5 for slow motion with strong flicker, 2 for fast motion.
strings.Wygładzanie na kadrze powiększonym ×2 (d: Smoothing on the crop scaled up ×2 (only the correction goes back to the result). Since 2026-10-28 the flow is computed at the plate's resolution, so ×1 came out just as calm (CLIP2_A −47 % vs −44 %) and ~3× faster (sh060 0.5 vs 1.5 s/frame). When ×2: very thin single strands; otherwise ×1 is enough.

strings.Czy kamera stała nieruchomo w obu przeja: Whether the camera stood still in both passes (beauty and this plate). Locked = one alignment for the whole shot from the median of the anchor frames (several times faster, robust to noise). Moving = every frame tracked separately (CoTracker3; most accurate, slower). Auto = decided from the frame-to-frame jitter of the models (0.5 px threshold) for the WHOLE measured range – a mixed shot (camera still, then moving) is treated as moving
strings.Auto: jedna decyzja dla całego mierzoneg: Auto: one decision for the whole measured range – camera locked only when the frame models jitter < 0.5 px; a mixed shot (camera still, then moving) is computed as moving. The measurement result says what it chose.
strings.Nieruchoma: jedno dopasowanie dla całego: Locked: one alignment for the whole shot from the median of the anchor frames – several times faster, noise averaged out; wrong when the camera or the set moves during the shot (even partly).
strings.Ruchoma: każda klatka śledzona osobno (C: Moving: every frame tracked separately (CoTracker3) – most accurate and safe for mixed shots, slowest.

strings.Wypełnienie {0}×{1} ma inny rozmiar niż: The fill {0}×{1} has a different size than the plate {2}×{3}
strings.Maska usuwanych obiektów ma inny rozmiar: The mask of the removed objects has a different size than the plate
strings.Jak łata z kluczy przechodzi w plate: ob: How the patch from the keys blends into the plate: the object + its traces (shadow, kicked-up sand) + a soft ramp outward
strings.Podgląd złożenia na bieżącej klatce, lic: Preview of the composite on the current frame, computed in the browser on every slider move (without tone match and motion blur – “Compute” adds them)
strings.Szerokość miękkiego przejścia łaty w pla: Width of the soft transition of the patch into the plate, outward from the object and its traces (frame px)
strings.Cień i ślady obiektu (kopnięty piasek) w: The object's shadow and traces (kicked-up sand) in every frame: where the plate clearly differs from the projected keys and touches the object
strings.Usuwaj cień i ślady obiektu: Remove the object's shadow and traces
strings.Jak duża różnica plate / klucze liczy si: How large a plate / keys difference counts as a trace of the object: lower = catches weaker shadows, but also more random spots
strings.Miękkość samej maski usuwania z kroku C1: Softness of the removal mask itself from step C1 (px); empty = the Cleanup setting
strings.Podgląd F{0}: ślady obiektu {1} tys. px: Preview F{0}: object traces {1}k px · {2} ms
strings.Nieznana część podglądu wtopienia: {0}: Unknown part of the blend preview: {0}
strings.Ujęcia z motion control: clear plate po: Motion control shots: the aligned clear plate fits every frame without a projection – the patch takes the clear plate first, the keys and LaMa only where it is missing or does not fit. Note: moving things (waves, clouds) and light changes between passes
strings.clear plate przed kluczami (motion contr: clear plate before the keys (motion control)
strings.Projekt nie ma clear plate'u – przełączn: The project has no clear plate – the switch changes nothing.
strings.Skąd karta bierze klatki kluczy: ręcznie: Where the card gets its key frames: manual (picked frames), every N frames of the work range, automatic (where the projection error grows) or one master key from all frames
strings.Średni błąd rzutu karty z sąsiednich klu: Mean projection error of the card from the neighbouring keys (plate vs projection outside the removed objects) above which a frame gets a key. Less = more keys
strings.Nowy klucz co najmniej tyle klatek od in: A new key at least this many frames from the other keys
strings.Nigdy dłuższa przerwa między kluczami (0: Never a longer gap between keys (0 = no limit)
strings.Policz błąd rzutu karty na zakresie prac: Measure the card's projection error over the work range and add keys where it exceeds the threshold (first key version = the plate frame). Existing keys stay
strings.Jeden klucz karty w bieżącej klatce, zło: One key of the card at the current frame, built from the clean background of all frames projected through the 3D camera (canvas larger than the frame). What no frame sees is marked as an area to regenerate
The card has no master key yet.
strings.Klucz-suma karty {0} powstanie w klatce: The master key of card {0} will be made at frame {1} and replace {2} keys (F{3}).
strings.– niewidoczne w żadnej klatce zaznaczone: – what no frame sees is marked for regeneration
strings.Kamera 3D nie ma żadnej klatki z zakresu: The 3D camera has no frame of the work range
strings.Kamera 3D nie ma klatki klucza {0}: The 3D camera has no key frame {0}
strings.Żadna klatka nie pokazuje czystego tła k: No frame shows the clean background of card {0} – a master key is not possible
strings.Klatka {0}: plate {1}×{2} nie pasuje do: Frame {0}: plate {1}×{2} does not match the 3D camera {3}×{4}
strings.Skrypt Nuke'a odtwarzający projekcję: ka: A Nuke script that rebuilds the projection: 3D camera, cards, keys through Project3D, distortion through STMap, Merge onto the plate through the removal mask
strings.Zapisz skrypt Nuke'a (.nk) z kamerą (Cam: Save a Nuke script (.nk) with the camera (Camera3 + a .chan file), cards (Card3D, sky as a sphere), keys (Read → Project3D with its own projector camera) and distortion (STMap) to <work>/inpaint/nuke/
strings.łata RGBA (Merge over w Nuke'u) i plate: the RGBA patch (Merge over in Nuke) and the plate "cleaned" are written on every pass; "Nuke" saves a .nk script that rebuilds the projection: 3D camera (Camera3 + .chan), cards (Card3D), keys (Project3D), distortion (STMap), the removal mask of the last pass.
strings.W skrypcie nie ma dopasowania rozmycia r: The script has no matched motion blur, tone match or backup key where the current one does not reach – the C5 pass does these.
Removal mask: the last C5 pass.
strings.Bez przebiegu C5 skrypt nie ma maski usu: Without a C5 pass the script has no removal mask.
strings.Maska usuwania z nieaktualnej projekcji: Removal mask from the stale projection {0} – compute C5 again.
strings.Brak kart z kluczami – nie ma czego wyek: No cards with keys – nothing to export to Nuke
strings.Brak przebiegu projekcji (C5) – Merge be: No projection pass (C5) – Merge without the removal mask; connect a mask by hand.
strings.Brak kart – dodaj karty w kroku C3: No cards – add cards in step C3
strings.Brak kluczy z aktywną wersją – dodaj klu: No keys with an active version – add keys in step C4
strings.Brak plików aktywnych wersji kluczy: {0}: Missing files of the active key versions: {0}
strings.Karta {0}: brak kluczy z aktywną wersją: Card {0}: no keys with an active version – skipped.
strings.Klucz {0} / F{1}: kamera 3D nie ma tej k: Key {0} / F{1}: the 3D camera has no such frame – skipped.
strings.klik przy krawędzi łaty = nowy punkt; żó: click near the patch edge = new point; yellow whisker = how far the patch reaches (Esc = done)
strings.brak punktów – łata sięga na zewnątrz o: no points – the patch reaches out by “Feather” everywhere
strings.O ile px łata obejmuje więcej niż sam ob: How many px the patch covers beyond the object itself (alpha from C1): the motion-blurred edge and hair lie outside the removal mask – without growing, a thin outline of the removed object stays. The keys are clean background, so growing is safe; applies to the “key” source only
strings.Punkty pasa łaty (jak pas krawędzi w eta: Patch band points (like the edge band of the cut-out stages, outer side only): yellow whisker = how far the patch reaches out at this place – further, to catch a shadow the automatic detection missed, or closer. A drag = a key in this frame; between keys the point follows the object
strings.Dodaj punkt pasa łaty: klik przy krawędz: Add a patch band point: click near the patch edge = new point (a key in this frame); drag the yellow whisker = how far the patch reaches out. Esc = done
strings.Usuń punkt pasa łaty: klik na punkt (alb: Remove a patch band point: click the point (or right-click it). Esc = done
strings.Usuń klucze pasa łaty w tej klatce: Delete the patch band keys in this frame
strings.Punkty pasa łaty edytujesz w podglądzie: Patch band points are edited in the live preview.
strings.Wymagane teraz: nie – tylko dogenerowani: Required now: no – only key regeneration in Cleanup mode (engine "Qwen-Image-2.1", recommended for removing an object from large areas; without it LaMa and FLUX 3 Image Klein + LoRA Restore remain). Downloads about 17.3 GB: model qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot 7.3 GB → models/diffusion_models, encoder qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot 9.4 GB → models/text_encoders, VAE qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16 0.68 GB → models/vae, from huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 (an interrupted download resumes). Licence: Qwen Research License – non-commercial only.
strings.Co ma być w miejscu obiektu (opcjonalnie: What should be where the object was (optional, in English)
strings.Qwen-Image-2.1 dostaje cały wycinek z ob: Qwen-Image-2.1 gets the whole crop with the object and the instruction "remove the object with its shadow and traces, continue the background"; add here what should be in its place, e.g. "wet sand with footprints, the sea behind" – empty = the instruction alone. Enter = Generate
strings.LaMa – szybko, małe obszary, bez opisu;: LaMa – fast, small areas, no description; Qwen-Image-2.1 – recommended for removing an object from large areas (instruction edit of the crop, about 40 s, non-commercial licence only); FLUX 3 Image Klein + LoRA Restore – texture restoration, not for filling holes
strings.Wymagane teraz: NIE – tylko dogenerowani: Required now: NO – only key regeneration in Cleanup mode (engine "Qwen-Image-2.1", recommended for removing an object from large areas; without it LaMa and FLUX 3 Image Klein + LoRA Restore remain).

strings.Ostatnia wersja – usuń cały klucz: Last version – delete the whole key
strings.Dogeneruj obszar klucza wybranym silniki: Regenerate the key area with the chosen engine from the chosen version → a new key version (the base version stays)
strings.Wersja klucza, od której zaczyna się ten: The key version this step starts from (default: the active one) – the same step with another engine or setting from the same base gives versions to compare
strings.Zaznaczenie = obszary narysowane w klucz: Selection = the areas drawn in the key (brush, curve, rectangle). Whole patch = everywhere the base version differs from the key frame's plate, with the C5 patch band – nothing to mark
strings.FLUX 3 Image Klein + LoRA Restore: siła: FLUX 3 Image Klein + LoRA Restore: redraw strength (denoise). 1.0 = draws anew; less = stays closer to what is there (starts from the base version's image). Default 1.0 for a selection, 0.9 for the whole patch

strings.Plate klatki {0} ma inny rozmiar niż klu: The plate of frame {0} has a different size than the key
strings.Morze to płaska karta: mały błąd kamery,: The sea is a flat card: a small error of the camera, the lens or the card height moves the projected horizon by a few px and the patch makes a step where it meets the plate. The match shifts the projection vertically onto the plate's horizon, fading out smoothly above and below
strings.Przesuń rzut kluczy pionowo tak, żeby je: Shift the projected keys vertically so their horizon lies on the plate's horizon (in „Compute” and in the live preview). The plate's horizon: a drawn line or automatic
strings.Na ile px w górę i w dół od horyzontu pr: Over how many px above and below the horizon the shift fades smoothly to zero (beyond it the projection stays unchanged)
strings.Narysuj linię horyzontu plate'u w bieżąc: Draw the plate's horizon line in the current frame with the curve editor (drag a point, click on the line = new point, Delete = remove point, Esc = done). Between drawn frames the line is interpolated, outside them the automatic detector works
strings.Usuń narysowaną linię horyzontu z bieżąc: Remove the drawn horizon line from the current frame (the automatic detector works again)
strings.Pokaż na klatce horyzont plate'u (niebie: Show on the frame the plate's horizon (blue dashed), the projected keys' horizon (orange) and the drawn line (yellow)

strings.Linia horyzontu potrzebuje co najmniej d: The horizon line needs at least two points
strings.VOID (Netflix) usuwa ruchomy obiekt z ca: VOID (Netflix) removes the moving object from the whole shot together with its effects (shadow, traces). Computed once over the work range at 1344×768; the keys take their fill from it: the original plate + VOID only where the object and its traces are
strings.Co widać po usunięciu (opis tła, po angi: What the shot shows after the removal (background description, in English)
strings.Opis ujęcia PO usunięciu obiektu dla VOI: Description of the shot AFTER the object is removed, for VOID, e.g. "an empty sandy beach at sunset, calm sea" – empty = a generic sentence
strings.Policz VOID na zakresie pracy (obiekty z: Compute VOID over the work range (objects of step C1; long – several minutes on the GPU), then new versions of every card's existing keys: the plate + the VOID fill only where the object and its traces are
strings.Nowe wersje kluczy wszystkich kart z ost: New key versions of every card from the last VOID run (without computing it again) – e.g. after adding keys
strings.SeedVR2 podbija łatę kluczy wybranej kar: SeedVR2 upscales the patch of the selected card's keys: one crop around the object, the keys as one clip (consistent texture – best with dense keys, every 2–4 frames), the result pasted into the plate only where the patch is. A new version of every key (the previous one stays for undo)

strings.Ziarno łaty: łata z kluczy (generatory,: Patch grain: the patch from the keys (generators, projection) is cleaner than the plate when the footage was not denoised on input – then grain with the plate's spectrum is added to it, new on every frame. strings.Wymagane teraz: nie – tylko silnik „Wan: Required now: no – only the "Wan 2.2 Fun VACE" engine in Inpaint (C1), an alternative to MiniMax-H3 on 12 GB cards. Apache-2.0 licence. Restart ComfyUI after installing.

strings.Wejście czyszczenia (2026-11-15): na czy: Cleanup input: what Inpaint works on – the original Beauty plate (default) or the result of an earlier Inpaint version (e.g. remove the earrings from the version with the replaced face). Pixels outside the patch also come from the input; frames that version does not have come from Beauty. Object masks come from Cut-out on the original
strings.Zastąp obiekt: w masce pojawia się nowa: Replace object: a new thing from the description appears in the mask. The new thing fits inside the mask – a bigger shape = a bigger "Generation margin" (the model draws in it), and the patch band decides how much of it goes into the image. Describe the look, not a change ("Transform into…" becomes an event halfway through the clip in MiniMax-H3)
strings.MiniMax-H3, „Zastąp”: od czego model zac: MiniMax-H3, "Replace": what the model starts from in the mask. 1.0 = from a hole (pure noise – the model does not see what was under the mask and guesses the expression). Less = starts from the noised plate: keeps the shape, pose and facial expression, changes the look (e.g. skin texture). Too little = the old look stays. "Remove from the shot" always starts from a hole – the model must not see the object it removes
strings.Wan 2.2 Fun VACE: rozdzielczość klipu i: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE: clip resolution and number of steps
strings.Zapas generowania (px) – wpisz i Enter: Generation margin (px) – type and press Enter
strings.Pas łaty – co z wygenerowanego materiału: Patch band – what of the generated material goes into the image. The same band system as in the cut-out stages, outer side only: the patch must cover the whole object, so there is no inset. The band belongs to the cleaned object (independent of the cut-out stages' band). It reaches at most the edge of what the model drew (generation margin + engine growth)
strings.Pas na zewnątrz = Erode / Dilate: plus –: Outer band = Erode / Dilate: plus – how many px outside the object's outline the patch is full (motion blur, soft edge, glow); minus – the patch narrowed into the object, its own edge stays from the plate (Replace: e.g. hair at the edge of a face). Dashed line = the band's edge. Band points widen / narrow it along the outline (only with plus), the slider scales the whole band
strings.Podgląd złożenia bieżącej klatki z obecn: Composite preview of the current frame with the current band (sliders and band points, unsaved ones too) – computed on the server from the saved model image, without running the model
strings.Sam obraz modelu tej wersji w bieżącej k: The model image alone of this version in the current frame – what the model drew before the patch band and protection composited it with the plate (its whole canvas, stretched onto the plate as in the composite). Tells whether something is in the model image or comes from compositing
strings.Złóż pokazaną wersję ponownie z obecnym: Recompose the shown version with the current patch band – a new version (the shown one stays), without running the model
strings.Pozostałe obiekty projektu zostają z ory: The project's other objects stay from the original: the patch goes under them only where they are transparent (their alpha – a soft hair edge stays soft). The band lines show the band of the cleaned object alone, before this cut
strings.Ziarno łaty modelu wideo – dokładane prz: Grain of the video model's patch – added when compositing
strings.Ziarno łaty: obraz modelu wideo (MiniMax: Patch grain: the video model's image (MiniMax-H3, Wan 2.2 Fun VACE, LTX-2.5) is smoother than the plate – then grain with the plate's spectrum is added to the patch, new in every frame (same seed = same result). Measured next to the patch, where the model and the plate show the same background
strings.auto = ziarno tylko gdy plate jest wyraź: auto = grain only when the plate is clearly noisier than the patch (a denoised plate = no change); on = always add the missing grain; off = never
strings.Mnoży brakujące ziarno: 1 = jak plate, m: Multiplies the missing grain: 1 = like the plate, less = subtler, more = stronger
strings.Pas łaty składa teraz wersję {0} (na pla: The patch band now composites version {0} (on the plate "cleaned"): the sliders and band points change how much of its model image goes into the frame. "Apply" = a new version without running the model.

strings.Pas {0} px przy „Usuń”: brzeg obiektu ({: Band {0} px with "Remove": the object's edge ({1} px) stays from the plate – a visible outline of the removed object.

strings.Pas ({0} px) sięga dalej niż model rysuj: The band ({0} px) reaches farther than the model draws (margin {1} + engine {2} px) – the patch will be cut at that edge. Increase "Generation margin" before computing.
strings.Ochrona wyłączona – łata może przykryć k: Protection off – the patch may cover any object.
strings.Chroniony: łata omija „{0}” (wchodzi pod: Protected: the patch avoids "{0}" (goes under it only where it is transparent). Untick = the patch may cover it (the lost-objects check ignores it too). The model draws under protected objects anyway – the composite brings them back with their alpha
Not protected: the patch may cover "{0}". Tick = the patch avoids it again

strings.Zapas generowania: o ile px wokół usuwan: Generation margin: how many px around the removed object the video model draws new image (model mask = the object grown by that much, hard, without band points or feather, also over protected objects – the composite brings them back with their alpha; the engine adds its own growth). Set it before "▶ Run Inpaint" – after computing only a new run changes it. A bigger margin = more material for the patch band
strings.model wideo: regeneruje tylko obszar mas: video model: regenerates only the mask area in the whole clip (1344×768 / 768×1344, 24 fps) – consistent in time; Remove or Replace with a description
strings.MiniMax-H3 – licencja „other”, sprawdź p: MiniMax-H3 – licence "other", check it before commercial work
strings.23,6 GB z LoRA Lightning (+7 GB koder /: 23.6 GB with the Lightning LoRA (+7 GB encoder / VAE when missing)
strings.model wideo Wan 2.2 Fun VACE A14B (GGUF: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE A14B video model (GGUF Q4_K_S): inpaints the mask in the whole clip (720p or 480p), Remove or Replace with a description, Qwen-Image-2.1 anchors as given frames – an alternative to MiniMax-H3 on 12 GB cards
strings.1,31 GB (IC-LoRA inpaintu; LTX-2.5 z eta: 1.31 GB (inpainting IC-LoRA; LTX-2.5 of stage 7 about 40 GB when missing)
strings.model wideo LTX-2.5 22B z IC-LoRA in-/ou: LTX-2.5 22B video model with the Lightricks in-/outpainting IC-LoRA: whole clip at once (long side 1024), green key under the mask, Remove or Replace with a scene description (not an edit instruction), Qwen-Image-2.1 anchors as keyframes
strings.lokalny asystent opisu: tłumaczy na angi: local prompt assistant: translates to English and rewrites the description by the rules of MiniMax-H3 / Wan 2.2 Fun VACE / Qwen-Image-2.1, looking at the frame with the marked object

strings.MiniMax-H3 maskuje klatki F{0}–F{1} jedn: MiniMax-H3 masks frames F{0}–F{1} with one latent token, so its mask of this frame = the union of the masks F{2}–F{3} (token ± 2 frames).

strings.Maska F{0} – klik = duży podgląd (zoom,: Mask F{0} – click = large preview (zoom, pan); red = patch, dashed lines = band edge and feather end, solid blue and light-blue background = what the model will draw (generation band + engine growth){1}.{2}
strings.Czerwień = łata (im mocniej, tym pełniej: Red = patch (the stronger, the fuller); dashed line = band edge, thin = feather end; light-blue background with a solid blue edge = what the model will draw (generation band + engine growth; also under protected objects).
